transcript.text: "About this wound — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you? That's the priority."
"Teach me something from the wild."
"There's more, but that's for another fire."
"What’s going on out there?"
"Michael is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."
"About that favor — we never finished."
"It's getting worse, not better. If it festers I'm no good to anyone — can't haul, can't hunt, can't watch. Just clean it out and wrap it tight."
"About what's been happening — we never finished."
"Sleep's gone strange. I tend the fire without being asked at odd hours now. Whatever gets me to morning."
"What happened next?"
Something eases in their shoulders. They're really talking to you now.
"Tell me more."
"Nobody says Michael's name right yet. We will. Give it a few days."
"Tell me more."
"I'm picking up Michael's share of the work. Someone should, and it might as well be me."
"Tell me more."
"That's... pretty much all of it, honestly."
"Yeah."
They nod slowly, not quite done, not quite continuing.
"What happened next?"
"Okay. We'll pick this up later."
